title: Bug Severity Classification with Fine-Tuned Open LLMs: A Paired Comparison with TF-IDF and CodeBERT Baselines on Eclipse Reports
title_zh: 基于微调开源大语言模型的缺陷严重性分类：在Eclipse报告上与TF-IDF和CodeBERT基线的成对比较

paragraphs.en: Open large language models (LLMs) small enough to run on a laptop are an obvious candidate for automatic bug severity prediction. We measure what they add over cheaper classifiers on one task: assigning one of four Bugzilla severity levels (Critical, Major, Minor, Trivial) to Eclipse bug reports. From a public dump of 361,006 unique Eclipse reports we draw a class-balanced sample of 20,000 rows and compare eleven configurations of nine model types: six TF-IDF classifiers, a fine-tuned CodeBERT encoder, and Llama 3 8B and Qwen 2.5 7B, each run zero-shot and after QLoRA fine-tuning. All eleven are scored on the same 2,000 held-out reports, with bootstrap intervals and McNemar tests. The zero-shot runs reach macro-F1 0.305 and 0.321, below every TF-IDF model (0.430–0.489). The fine-tuned runs reach 0.526 and 0.485, but the zero-shot and fine-tuned setups also differ in checkpoint, serving runtime and decoding, so this gap cannot be credited to fine-tuning alone. Fine-tuned Llama 3 shows no detectable difference from CodeBERT (0.518; difference + 0.007 +0.007 , 95% CI − 0.017 -0.017 to + 0.032 +0.032 ), and fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 is below it on macro-F1. The models differ more by class than in aggregate: fine-tuned Llama 3 finds 36% of Critical reports, Qwen 2.5 finds 69% but only 21% of Minor ones. The dump repeats 60,000 rows, and 8% of the test reports duplicate a training report; removing them lowers TF-IDF scores by up to 0.031 and leaves the LLMs almost unchanged. We release split identifiers, per-report predictions and the analysis script at https://github.com/tbayan/bug_finetuning_llm_artifacts , together with CyberTriage, a tool that serves the fine-tuned classifier locally.
paragraphs.zh: 能够在笔记本电脑上运行的开源大语言模型（LLMs），因其规模足够小，是自动缺陷严重性预测的显而易见的候选方案。 我们在一个任务上衡量了它们相较于更廉价分类器所增加的价值：为 Eclipse 缺陷报告分配四个 Bugzilla 严重性级别之一（Critical、Major、Minor、Trivial）。 从包含 361,006 份唯一 Eclipse 报告的公开转储中，我们抽取了类别均衡的 20,000 行样本，并比较九种模型类型的十一种配置：六个 TF-IDF 分类器、一个经过微调的 CodeBERT 编码器，以及 Llama 3 8B 和 Qwen 2.5 7B，后者各自以零样本方式和 QLoRA 微调后运行。 全部十一种配置都在相同的 2,000 份留出报告上评分，并使用自助法置信区间和 McNemar 检验。 零样本运行达到宏平均 F1 0.305 和 0.321，低于所有 TF-IDF 模型（0.430–0.489）。 微调后的运行达到 0.526 和 0.485，但零样本和微调设置在检查点、服务运行时和解码方面也存在差异，因此这一差距不能仅归功于微调。 微调后的 Llama 3 与 CodeBERT 之间没有可检测到的差异（0.518；差异 +0.007，95% 置信区间为 −0.017 到 +0.032），而微调后的 Qwen 2.5 在宏平均 F1 上低于 CodeBERT。 这些模型在各类别上的差异大于总体差异：微调后的 Llama 3 能识别出 36% 的 Critical 报告，Qwen 2.5 能识别出 69% 的 Critical 报告，但只能识别出 21% 的 Minor 报告。 该转储中重复了 60,000 行，且有 8% 的测试报告与训练报告重复；移除这些重复项会使 TF-IDF 分数最多降低 0.031，而 LLM 的分数几乎保持不变。 我们在 https://github.com/tbayan/bug_finetuning_llm_artifacts 发布了数据集划分标识符、逐报告的预测结果和分析脚本，同时发布了 CyberTriage——一个在本地部署微调后分类器的工具。

paragraphs.en: When a reporter files a bug in Bugzilla, they pick a severity from a fixed list that runs from blocker to trivial , and triagers use that field to decide what gets looked at first. A wrong value costs most when the defect is a security or privacy weakness. Such weaknesses keep reaching deployed software: in permissionless blockchains, privacy flaws [ 5 ] and smart-contract and signature vulnerabilities have led to documented incidents, and a secure development lifecycle with measurable security controls has been proposed to catch them during development [ 9 ] . The field is often unreliable. In the Eclipse collection we study, two thirds of all reports are labelled normal , the default value, and Tian et al. [28] found that about half of the duplicate reports in Eclipse, Mozilla and OpenOffice carry different severities even though they describe the same problem. Predicting severity from the report text has therefore been studied for well over a decade, starting with rule learners and Naive Bayes over word features [ 23 , 20 ] and moving through deep networks [ 26 , 10 ] to pre-trained encoders [ 3 , 1 ] and, recently, generative LLMs [ 27 , 4 , 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 当报告者在 Bugzilla 中提交缺陷时，需要从一份固定的列表中选择严重性级别，范围从阻塞到琐碎，分类人员利用该字段来决定优先处理哪些问题。 当缺陷是安全或隐私弱点时，错误的取值代价最大。 这类弱点不断出现在已部署的软件中：在无许可区块链中，隐私缺陷[5]以及智能合约和签名漏洞已导致多起有据可查的事故，有人提出了带有可度量安全控制的安全开发生命周期，以便在开发阶段捕获这些问题[9]。 该字段往往并不可靠。 在我们研究的 Eclipse 数据集中，三分之二的报告被标记为正常，即默认值，而 Tian 等人 [28]发现，Eclipse、Mozilla 和 OpenOffice 中大约一半的重复报告尽管描述的是同一问题，却带有不同的严重性级别。 因此，从报告文本预测严重性的研究已持续十余年，早期采用基于词特征的规则学习器和朴素贝叶斯[23,20]，随后经历深度网络[26,10]、预训练编码器[3,1]，直至近期的生成式大语言模型[27,4,2]。

paragraphs.en: Open models with 7–8 billion parameters are a natural next step. QLoRA lets them be adapted on a single GPU [ 11 ] , and once quantised they run on a laptop, so a team could keep its reports in-house. What is less clear is whether they beat a fine-tuned encoder that is sixty times smaller. Published comparisons rarely settle this, because they differ in data, label scheme, split and metric, and few of them score every model on the same reports with a measure of uncertainty.

paragraphs.en: This paper compares eleven configurations of nine model types on one task and one split: TF-IDF classifiers, a fine-tuned CodeBERT encoder [ 14 ] , and two open LLMs, Llama 3 8B [ 15 ] and Qwen 2.5 7B [ 25 ] , used both zero-shot and after QLoRA fine-tuning. All are scored on the same 2,000 test reports. The work grew out of a master’s thesis. The LLM scores reported in that thesis, and those shown by the evaluation screen of the original CyberTriage code, were computed by a scoring routine that added synthetic correct predictions, 25% as many as the real ones, before computing the metrics. For this paper we recomputed every number with one script from the raw data dump, the real per-report predictions and the training logs; these numbers supersede the thesis values, and we report only what the records support. The code released with this paper no longer uses that routine and keeps it only as a record. As in our earlier data releases, which publish the raw outputs and aggregated metrics of every run [ 7 , 6 ] , we release the split identifiers, the per-report predictions and the analysis script. Three questions guide the analysis.

paragraphs.en: An audit of the public Hugging Face dump used here, showing that it holds Eclipse reports only, repeats 60,000 rows, has fewer unique Trivial reports than the sampling asked for, and lets 8% of the test reports duplicate a training report, together with the measured effect of each issue.
paragraphs.zh: 对本文所使用的 Hugging Face 公开数据转储的审计表明：它仅包含 Eclipse 报告，重复了 60,000 行，唯一 Trivial 报告的数量少于抽样所要求的数量，并且有 8% 的测试报告与训练报告重复，同时还给出了每个问题经测量产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: Measurements of the two fine-tuned LLMs in this setting: far above the zero-shot runs, though in a setup that differs in more than training; no detectable difference from CodeBERT at about 27 times its per-report latency; and different per-class trade-offs between the two.
paragraphs.zh: 在此设置下对两个微调后的大语言模型的测量结果：远高于零样本运行的结果，尽管该设置在训练之外还有其他差异；与 CodeBERT 相比没有可检测的差异，但其每份报告的延迟约为后者的 27 倍；且两个智能体之间存在不同的各类权衡。

paragraphs.en: Menzies and Marcus [23] were among the first to predict severity automatically, applying the Ripper rule learner to terms selected with TF-IDF and information gain from NASA defect reports with five severity levels. Lamkanfi et al. [20] framed the Bugzilla version of the task as a binary one, grouping blocker , critical and major as severe and minor and trivial as non-severe, and trained Naive Bayes on three open-source projects; a follow-up comparison on Eclipse and GNOME found multinomial Naive Bayes ahead of plain Naive Bayes, k k -nearest neighbours and support vector machines [ 21 ] . Tian et al. [29] kept the five Bugzilla levels and predicted them with a BM25-based nearest-neighbour method whose similarity weights were learned from duplicate reports, and Yang et al. [32] combined topic models with several report features to find similar historical reports for severity prediction. Later work replaced hand-built features with neural networks: Ramay et al. [26] fed text vectors and an emotion score to a deep network, and Dao and Yang [10] combined content, sentiment, quality and reporter features in a convolutional network evaluated on Eclipse and Mozilla.
paragraphs.zh: Menzies 和 Marcus [23] 是最早进行严重程度自动预测的研究者之一，他们将 Ripper 规则学习器应用于从具有五个严重程度的 NASA 缺陷报告中通过 TF-IDF 和信息增益筛选出的术语上。Lamkanfi 等人 [20] 将 Bugzilla 版本的该任务构造成二分类问题，把 blocker、critical 和 major 归为严重，把 minor 和 trivial 归为非严重，并在三个开源项目上训练了朴素贝叶斯；随后在 Eclipse 和 GNOME 上的对比研究发现，多项朴素贝叶斯优于普通朴素贝叶斯、k 近邻和支持向量机 [21]。Tian 等人 [29] 保留了 Bugzilla 的五个级别，使用一种基于 BM25 的最近邻方法来预测它们，其相似度权重从重复报告中学得；Yang 等人 [32] 将主题模型与若干报告特征相结合，为严重程度预测寻找相似的历史报告。 后续工作用神经网络取代了手工构建的特征：Ramay 等人 [26] 将文本向量和情感分数输入深度网络，Dao 和 Yang [10] 则在卷积网络中结合了内容、情感、质量和报告者特征，并在 Eclipse 和 Mozilla 上进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Two points from this work matter here. Many studies drop the normal label, because it is the Bugzilla default and many reporters never change it [ 27 ] , and the label itself is noisy: Tian et al. [28] found inconsistent severities for about 51% of duplicate reports and argued that agreement with the recorded label is an imperfect yardstick.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作中的两点在此值得关注。 许多研究去掉了 normal 标签，因为它是 Bugzilla 的默认值且许多报告者从不修改它 [ 27 ] ，而且该标签本身噪声很大：Tian 等人 [28] 发现约 51% 的重复报告的严重级别不一致，并认为与记录标签是否一致是一个不完善的衡量标准。

[3] fine-tuned BERT together with a sentiment signal on mobile-application reports, and Agarwal and Madhavan [1] compared fine-tuned code models for severity prediction in a study built on GraphCodeBERT and LoRA. paragraphs.en: Beyond severity, Hou et al. [17] survey LLM use across software engineering, and Kiashemshaki et al. [19] apply instruction-tuned LLMs with constrained decoding to developer assignment, a different triage task. LoRA [ 18 ] trains low-rank updates next to frozen weights, and QLoRA [ 11 ] keeps the frozen weights in 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) so that a 7–8B model can be tuned on one GPU. We use QLoRA as an off-the-shelf method; it is not a contribution of this paper.

paragraphs.en: We use the Hugging Face dataset AndressaStefany/bug-reports 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/AndressaStefany/bug-reports , a CSV export with six columns: an internal record identifier, the Bugzilla bug_id , the free-text description , bug_severity , bug_status and resolution . The dataset has no card, so we identified it from its contents. The file holds 421,006 rows, but the last 60,000 rows are exact copies of earlier ones (bug IDs 1 to 62,767), leaving 361,006 unique reports with bug IDs up to 424,785. The repeats come from the dataset repository itself: it stores two CSV files, eclipse_clear.csv with 361,006 rows and my_dataset.csv with 60,000 rows that copy the first 60,000 of the former, and the standard loader joins both into one split. That count and the per-label counts in Table 2 match exactly the Eclipse collection described by Silva de Oliveira [27] , who also used a separate Mozilla collection of 768,335 reports that is not part of this dump. The resolution values include NOT_ECLIPSE , and 38% of the unique descriptions mention Eclipse by name. We therefore treat the data as Eclipse-only.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 lists every label in the dump. Two of them were excluded: normal , which covers 67.3% of unique reports and is the Bugzilla default, and enhancement , which marks feature requests (12.6%). The remaining five were mapped to four classes by merging blocker and critical into Critical. After the mapping, 432 rows with empty descriptions were dropped, leaving a pool of 83,488 rows (72,337 unique reports). paragraphs.en: Sampling from rows rather than unique reports has two consequences. First, the pool holds only 4,778 unique Trivial reports, fewer than the 5,000 requested, so repeated rows were bound to enter the sample; 962 bug IDs appear twice in the 20,000 rows, 519 of them Trivial, so the sample holds 19,038 distinct reports. Second, repeats can land on both sides of the split: 319 test reports (8.0%) have a description identical to a training report, 175 of them Trivial. Balancing before splitting does not by itself prevent this kind of leakage. Section 5.3 measures its effect. The text itself also shows some label noise: among the unique pool reports, 41 descriptions are filed under more than one bug ID with conflicting severities (243 reports in all). We did not inspect a sample of reports manually, so we make no claim about the overall noise rate.
paragraphs.zh: 按行抽样而非按唯一报告抽样会带来两个后果。 首先，池中只有 4,778 份唯一的 Trivial 报告，少于请求的 5,000 份，因此重复的行必然会进入样本；有 962 个 bug ID 在 20,000 行中出现了两次，其中 519 个是 Trivial，因此样本共包含 19,038 份不同的报告。 其次，重复项可能同时落在划分的两侧：319 份测试报告（8.0%）的描述与某份训练报告完全相同，其中 175 份是 Trivial。 在划分之前做平衡本身并不能防止这种泄漏。 第 5.3 节测量了其影响。 文本本身也存在一些标签噪声：在唯一池报告中有 41 份描述被归档在多个 bug ID 下，且严重级别相互冲突（共计 243 份报告）。 我们没有对报告样本进行人工检查，因此不对总体噪声率做任何断言。

paragraphs.en: Text was vectorised with TF-IDF over word 1–3-grams (20,000 features, sublinear term frequency, English stop words removed, minimum document frequency 5, maximum 0.75). Six scikit-learn classifiers [ 24 ] were trained: multinomial Naive Bayes with uniform class priors, logistic regression, linear SVM, random forest, XGBoost, and a soft-voting ensemble of logistic regression, a calibrated linear SVM, random forest and Naive Bayes. Hyperparameters were chosen by 10-fold grid search on macro-F1 (selected values: C = 1 C{=}1 for logistic regression, C = 0.1 C{=}0.1 for the SVM, 500 trees and min_samples_split = 5 {=}5 for the forest, α = 10 \alpha{=}10 for Naive Bayes, 200 trees of depth 10 for XGBoost). Inside the ensemble, the members keep fixed settings ( C = 1 C{=}1 for both linear models, 300 trees, α = 0.1 \alpha{=}0.1 ) and only the voting weights were searched, giving ( 2 , 2 , 1 , 1 ) (2,2,1,1) . Two details of the training script matter. The classifiers were fit on 12,800 of the 16,000 training reports; the other 3,200 served only as a printed check. And the vectoriser was fit once on those 12,800 reports before the grid search, so the cross-validation folds share its vocabulary and inverse document frequencies. This touches hyperparameter choice only; the test split was not involved.
paragraphs.zh: 文本使用 TF-IDF 在词级 1–3 元语法上进行向量化（20,000 个特征，次线性词频，去除英语停用词，最小文档频率为 5，最大为 0.75）。 训练了六个 scikit-learn 分类器 [ 24 ]：均匀类先验的多项式朴素贝叶斯、逻辑回归、线性支持向量机、随机森林、XGBoost，以及由逻辑回归、经校准的线性支持向量机、随机森林和朴素贝叶斯组成的软投票集成模型。 超参数通过 10 折网格搜索按宏平均 F1 选取（选定值：逻辑回归的 C = 1 C{=}1，支持向量机的 C = 0.1 C{=}0.1，随机森林为 500 棵树且 min_samples_split = 5 {=}5，朴素贝叶斯的 α = 10 \alpha{=}10，XGBoost 为 200 棵深度为 10 的树）。 在集成模型内部，各成员保持固定设置（两个线性模型均为 C = 1 C{=}1，300 棵树，α = 0.1 \alpha{=}0.1），仅对投票权重进行搜索，得到 ( 2 , 2 , 1 , 1 ) (2,2,1,1)。 训练脚本有两个细节值得注意。 分类器在 16,000 份训练报告中的 12,800 份上进行拟合；其余 3,200 份仅用作打印核对。 并且向量化器在网格搜索之前先在这 12,800 份报告上拟合一次，因此各交叉验证折共享其词表和逆文档频率。 这仅涉及超参数选择；测试集并未参与其中。

paragraphs.en: CodeBERT [ 14 ] (RoBERTa-base architecture, 124.6M parameters) was fine-tuned end-to-end with a four-way classification head using Hugging Face Transformers [ 31 ] . Inputs were truncated at 512 tokens, which cuts 13.2% of the test reports. Training ran for three epochs (Table 3 ). The training script evaluated on the test split after every epoch and kept the checkpoint with the best test macro-F1. The three per-epoch values were 0.478, 0.526 and 0.532, so the kept checkpoint is the final one and equals what a fixed three-epoch schedule would have produced; the test split was nonetheless consulted during training, and we flag it here rather than retrain.
paragraphs.zh: CodeBERT [ 14 ]（RoBERTa-base 架构，124.6M 参数）使用 Hugging Face Transformers [ 31 ] 进行了带四分类头的端到端微调。 输入在 512 个 token 处被截断，这截掉了 13.2% 的测试报告。 训练运行了三个轮次（表 3 ）。 训练脚本在每个轮次结束后都在测试集上进行评估，并保留测试宏 F1 最好的检查点。 三个轮次的值分别为 0.478、0.526 和 0.532，因此保留的检查点就是最后一个，与固定三轮次调度所产生的结果相同；尽管如此，测试集在训练期间被参考过，我们在此予以指出而不重新训练。

paragraphs.en: Local LLM inference was slow, so the evaluation scripts drew 2,000 of the 4,000 test reports with NumPy’s generator seeded at 42 and ran the four LLM configurations on that subset. We regenerated the sampling indices with the same call, checked that every stored LLM prediction matches its test row in text and gold label, and re-scored the six TF-IDF classifiers and CodeBERT from their saved model files on the same 2,000 reports. The subset contains 495 Critical, 505 Major, 491 Minor and 509 Trivial reports. Re-scoring the non-LLM models on all 4,000 reports reproduces the logged metrics to the fourth decimal (Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 本地大语言模型推理速度较慢，因此评估脚本使用以 42 为种子的 NumPy 随机数生成器从 4,000 份测试报告中抽取了 2,000 份，并在该子集上运行四种大语言模型配置。 我们用相同的调用重新生成了抽样索引，核对了每条已存储的大语言模型预测在文本和金标准标签上与其对应的测试行完全一致，并从保存的模型文件出发，在同样的 2,000 份报告上对六个 TF-IDF 分类器和 CodeBERT 重新评分。 该子集包含 495 份 Critical、505 份 Major、491 份 Minor 和 509 份 Trivial 报告。 在全部 4,000 份报告上对非大语言模型重新评分，可将记录的指标复现到小数点后四位（附录 A）。

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot and fine-tuned outputs went through the same parser. It tries to read the whole response, and then the span from its first { to its last } , as a JSON object, and accepts the severity value if it equals one of the four labels, ignoring case. Otherwise it strips punctuation from the whole response and checks for the label names in the fixed order Critical, Major, Minor, Trivial, taking the first one that occurs anywhere. Only when no label name occurs, as in an empty response, a failed request or an answer such as “Blocker” or “High”, does it record Minor. Every report counts in the metrics; none is dropped. The raw responses were not stored, so we cannot report how often each step fired or how many responses broke the requested format. The zero-shot errors therefore mix wrong labels with unusable output, and some Minor predictions may come from the default.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本输出与微调后的输出经过同一个解析器处理。 它会尝试读取整个响应，然后读取从第一个 { 到最后一个 } 的区间，将其解析为 JSON 对象；如果严重性值等于四个标签之一（不区分大小写），则接受该值。 否则，它会去除整个响应中的标点符号，并按照 Critical、Major、Minor、Trivial 的固定顺序检查标签名，取第一个出现在任意位置的标签。 只有当没有任何标签名出现时——例如响应为空、请求失败或答案为 “Blocker” 或 “High” 之类——才会记录为 Minor。 每份报告都计入指标，没有一份被丢弃。 原始响应未被保存，因此我们无法报告每个步骤被触发的频率，或有多少响应不符合所要求的格式。 因此，零样本的错误混合了错误标签与不可用的输出，而且某些 Minor 预测可能来自默认值。

paragraphs.en: Intervals come from a percentile bootstrap over reports [ 13 ] : we resampled the 2,000 reports with replacement 10,000 times and took the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of each statistic. The same resamples are used for every model, so intervals for between-model differences are paired. For ten comparisons selected from the research questions (Table 5 ) we report a two-sided bootstrap p p -value for the macro-F1 difference, taken as twice the smaller share of resampled differences on either side of zero (an approximation obtained by inverting the interval), and an exact McNemar test of accuracy on the reports that exactly one of the two models gets right [ 22 , 12 ] . Each family of ten p p -values is corrected with Holm’s procedure [ 16 ] . We call a difference detectable when its 95% interval excludes zero and its adjusted p p -value is below 0.05. Reports are treated as independent, although the shared subset contains 18 repeated descriptions, and each model was trained once, so seed-to-seed variation is not part of these intervals.
paragraphs.zh: 区间来自对报告的百分位自助法（bootstrap）[13]：我们对2,000份报告进行有放回重抽样10,000次，并取每个统计量的第2.5百分位数和第97.5百分位数。 相同的重抽样样本用于每个模型，因此模型间差异的区间是配对的。 对于从研究问题中选取的十项比较（表5），我们报告宏F1（macro-F1）差异的双侧自助法 p p 值（该值取零两侧较小的重抽样差异比例的两倍，即通过反转区间得到的近似值），以及针对恰好被两个模型之一判对的报告的准确率的精确McNemar检验 [22, 12]。 每组十个 p p 值均使用Holm程序进行校正 [16]。 当一个差异的95%区间不包含零且其校正后的 p p 值低于0.05时，我们称该差异是可检测的。 报告被视为相互独立，尽管共享子集中包含18条重复描述；此外每个模型仅训练一次，因此种子间的变异不包含在这些区间中。

paragraphs.en: The per-class picture (Table 6 , Figure 4 ) shows how the two conditions differ. Both zero-shot runs pull reports towards Minor, possibly in part through the parser default: Llama 3 predicts Minor for 1,276 of the 2,000 reports and Qwen 2.5 for 1,353, whereas Trivial is predicted 31 and 90 times. When they do say Critical they are usually right (precision 0.741 and 0.700), but they say it rarely, so Critical recall is 0.162 and 0.127.
paragraphs.zh: 分类别的结果（表6、图4）展示了两种条件之间的差异。 两个零样本运行都将报告拉向 Minor，部分原因可能是解析器的默认值：Llama 3 在 2,000 份报告中对 1,276 份预测为 Minor，Qwen 2.5 对 1,353 份预测为 Minor，而 Trivial 分别只被预测了 31 次和 90 次。 当它们确实预测为 Critical 时通常是正确的（精确率分别为 0.741 和 0.700），但它们很少这样预测，因此 Critical 的召回率仅为 0.162 和 0.127。

paragraphs.en: After fine-tuning the two models settle into opposite trade-offs. Llama 3 leans towards Major, which it predicts 866 times. It finds 177 of the 495 Critical reports (recall 0.358, interval 0.316–0.400) and labels 293 of the rest Major, so 64% of Critical reports are missed, most of them one level down. Qwen 2.5 leans towards the two ends of the scale. It finds 69% of Critical reports (recall 0.691, interval 0.651–0.731) and 83% of Trivial ones, at the price of calling 242 Major reports Critical and 279 of the 491 Minor reports Trivial, leaving Minor recall at 0.214. CodeBERT is more even, with recall between 0.440 and 0.648 for every class.

paragraphs.en: The small change for the fine-tuned LLMs does not show that they handle duplicates better. On the 159 shared reports whose text and label appear in training, random forest and XGBoost are right 86% and 87% of the time, CodeBERT 68%, fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 66% and fine-tuned Llama 3 56%; on the other shared reports the same five models score 46%, 44%, 50%, 51% and 52%. The gain on seen reports is 40 and 43 points for the two tree models, 18 for CodeBERT, 15 for Qwen 2.5 and only 4 for Llama 3. With 159 reports each of these rates is uncertain by up to about ± \pm 8 points, and only 126 of the 159 were in the 12,800 reports the TF-IDF models were fit on. Fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 therefore behaves much like CodeBERT, while fine-tuned Llama 3 gains little from having seen a report. Three explanations are possible for Llama 3 and we cannot separate them: limited fitting after three epochs of LoRA at a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , the training loss, in which the 6 or 7 answer tokens are a small part of each record, and the export from NF4 training to a Q4_K_M file. Since 175 of the 319 repeated test reports are Trivial, the effect of duplication falls mostly on that class.

paragraphs.en: The test set is balanced, but the pool is not. As an estimate, not a measurement, we re-weighted each model’s confusion matrix to the pool’s class mix (Major 48.6%, Critical 26.3%, Minor 18.5%, Trivial 6.6%), assuming each model keeps its per-class behaviour. Under that mix the estimated macro-F1 falls by 0.046 to 0.078 for the TF-IDF classifiers, by 0.056 for CodeBERT (to 0.462) and by 0.080 for fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 (to 0.405), but by only 0.009 for fine-tuned Llama 3 (to 0.517). The reason is Trivial precision. With Trivial reports scarce, models that predict Trivial generously produce mostly false alarms: Trivial precision drops to 0.242 for Qwen 2.5 and 0.333 for CodeBERT, against 0.424 for Llama 3, whose errors go to the now common Major class. Under this estimate fine-tuned Llama 3 leads CodeBERT by 0.055 (95% bootstrap interval 0.029 to 0.081), but the interval does not cover the re-weighting assumption itself. paragraphs.en: Table 7 lists the wall-clock times logged by the evaluation scripts on the M1 Pro. paragraphs.en: The fine-tuned models are packaged in CyberTriage, an open web application with a React front end and a FastAPI back end, released with the analysis code at https://github.com/tbayan/bug_finetuning_llm_artifacts . It runs in the browser, so practitioners can use the models without running scripts, and, like our earlier web-based platform with multimodal search [ 8 ] , it accepts more than one kind of input: reports can be typed, uploaded as PDF, DOCX, TXT, LOG or JSON files, or dictated through the browser’s speech-recognition interface. A registry lets the user pick any of the evaluated models. Analysed reports are kept in a history view and can be exported as a Jira import file, with Critical, Major, Minor and Trivial mapped to the Jira priorities Highest, High, Low and Lowest.

paragraphs.en: For the fine-tuned models, a single analysis runs in two stages (Figure 5 ). Stage 1 is the fine-tuned classifier evaluated above and produces only the label. Stage 2 sends the report and that label to the zero-shot instruction model of the same family. Its prompt states the label, tells the model not to disagree with it, and asks for a technical justification, a one-line summary and a short description as JSON (temperature 0.3, up to 1,024 tokens). The back end copies only those three fields from the Stage 2 response; a severity field in that response, if present, is ignored. The guarantee is therefore narrow and enforced in code, not by the prompt or the interface: Stage 2 cannot change the stored label. It is not a guarantee of correctness. The pipeline’s label is Stage 1’s label, which is wrong for 47% (Llama 3) and 48% (Qwen 2.5) of the shared test reports, and the Stage 2 text is a post-hoc rationale written by a different model from the one that decided. We expect it to justify a wrong label as readily as a right one, but we have not evaluated the explanations, and we did not time Stage 2, so we give no end-to-end latency for the two-stage path.

paragraphs.en: The gap between the zero-shot and fine-tuned runs is large, but it should not be read as the value of task learning alone. Training was not the only thing that changed (Section 5.2 ): checkpoint, prompt template, serving stack, quantisation format and decoding settings changed with it. With the raw responses gone we also cannot separate format failures from wrong answers, so the Minor bias of the zero-shot runs may partly reflect the parser default. A clean test of what fine-tuning adds would run the same checkpoint under four conditions (plain zero-shot, zero-shot with output constrained to the four labels, constrained few-shot, and fine-tuned with the same constraint) and report output validity separately. We have not done this.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本运行与微调运行之间的差距很大，但这不应被解读为单纯体现任务学习的价值。 发生变化的不只是训练本身（见 5.2 节）：检查点、提示模板、服务栈、量化格式和解码设置都随之改变了。 由于原始响应已丢失，我们也无法将格式错误与答案错误区分开来，因此零样本运行中的 Minor 偏差可能部分反映了解析器的默认行为。 要干净地检验微调带来了什么，应当在四种条件下运行同一个检查点（纯零样本、输出限制为四个标签的零样本、受限少样本，以及带有相同限制的微调），并单独报告输出有效性。我们并没有这样做。

sents.zh: 零样本运行与微调运行之间的差距很大，但这不应被解读为单纯体现任务学习的价值。

sents.en: Training was not the only thing that changed (Section 5.2 ): checkpoint, prompt template, serving stack, quantisation format and decoding settings changed with it.
sents.zh: 发生变化的不只是训练本身（见 5.2 节）：检查点、提示模板、服务栈、量化格式和解码设置都随之改变了。

sents.en: With the raw responses gone we also cannot separate format failures from wrong answers, so the Minor bias of the zero-shot runs may partly reflect the parser default.
sents.zh: 由于原始响应已丢失，我们也无法将格式错误与答案错误区分开来，因此零样本运行中的 Minor 偏差可能部分反映了解析器的默认行为。

sents.en: A clean test of what fine-tuning adds would run the same checkpoint under four conditions (plain zero-shot, zero-shot with output constrained to the four labels, constrained few-shot, and fine-tuned with the same constraint) and report output validity separately. We have not done this.
sents.zh: 要干净地检验微调带来了什么，应当在四种条件下运行同一个检查点（纯零样本、输出限制为四个标签的零样本、受限少样本，以及带有相同限制的微调），并单独报告输出有效性。我们并没有这样做。

paragraphs.en: What the data do show is that fine-tuning on 16,000 labelled reports did not take an 8B model detectably beyond a fully fine-tuned 125M encoder on this test set; the interval allows a difference of up to 0.032 in favour of Llama 3 or 0.017 in favour of CodeBERT. On the balanced test set the practical case for the LLM is therefore weak: it costs far more per report on the same laptop (Table 7 ) and three hours of A100 time to train. Our prevalence estimate is the one result pointing the other way, and it depends on an assumption we could not test.
paragraphs.zh: 数据确实表明的是，在该测试集上，用16,000份有标注报告进行微调，并未使一个8B模型以可察觉的方式超越一个完全微调的125M编码器；该区间允许存在最高0.032（有利于Llama 3）或0.017（有利于CodeBERT）的差异。 因此，在均衡测试集上，大语言模型在实用层面的理由是薄弱的：在同一台笔记本电脑上它每份报告的成本高得多（表7），并且需要三个小时的A100训练时间。 我们的患病率估计是唯一指向相反方向的结果，而它依赖于一个我们无法验证的假设。

paragraphs.en: The two fine-tuned models also disagree with each other more than their aggregate scores suggest. Under identical data, prompt and hyperparameters they ended with opposite biases, one towards Major and one towards the ends of the scale. We trained each model once and cannot say how much of this would survive another seed, so we do not attribute it to the architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 两个微调后的模型之间的分歧也比它们的总体得分所显示的更大。 在相同的数据、提示词和超参数下，它们最终形成了相反的偏差，一个偏向「Major」，一个偏向量表的两端。 我们对每个模型只训练了一次，无法确定这种差异在更换随机种子后还能保留多少，因此我们不将其归因于模型架构。

sents.zh: 两个微调后的模型之间的分歧也比它们的总体得分所显示的更大。

paragraphs.en: For triage, the per-class numbers matter more than the aggregate. Fine-tuned Llama 3 misses 64% of Critical reports and Qwen 2.5 misses 31%; CodeBERT misses 53%. With Critical recall between 0.36 and 0.69 for these three models, and lower for the zero-shot runs, no model here should route reports without a person checking the result, least of all where a missed Critical report has a real cost. The models are more useful as a second opinion than as a gate. Because most misses land one level down, reviewing every report predicted Major or above catches most Critical reports, at the cost of a long queue: on our balanced set this covers 95% of Critical reports for fine-tuned Llama 3 but means reviewing 57% of all reports, against 84% and 47% for CodeBERT. At the pool’s class mix, where Major is common, the queue would grow to about 74% and 62% of reports. With score-based models one could instead lower the decision threshold for Critical and choose it on held-out data; we did not evaluate this.
paragraphs.zh: 在分诊场景中，每类别的数字比总体数字更重要。 微调后的 Llama 3 漏掉 64% 的 Critical 报告，Qwen 2.5 漏掉 31%；CodeBERT 漏掉 53%。 这三个模型的 Critical 召回率在 0.36 到 0.69 之间，零样本运行的结果更低，因此这里的任何模型都不应在没有人工检查结果的情况下对报告进行路由，尤其是在漏掉 Critical 报告会造成实际损失的场合。 这些模型更适合作为第二意见，而不是作为守门者。 由于大多数漏判仅低一个级别，因此审查所有预测为 Major 及以上的报告可以捕获大多数 Critical 报告，但代价是队伍很长：在我们的均衡数据集上，这覆盖了微调后 Llama 3 的 95% 的 Critical 报告，但意味着要审查全部报告的 57%，而 CodeBERT 的对应数字是 84% 和 47%。 在该数据池的类别分布下（Major 很常见），队伍将增长到全部报告的约 74% 和 62%。 对于基于分数的模型，可以改为降低 Critical 的判定阈值，并在留出数据上选择该阈值；我们没有评估这种方法。

paragraphs.en: We follow the usual four categories [ 30 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循通常的四分类法 [ 30 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. The ground truth is the severity recorded in Bugzilla, which is noisy [ 28 ] ; 41 identical descriptions in our pool carry conflicting labels, and we did not audit a sample by hand. Merging blocker into Critical and dropping normal define a narrower task than real triage, where normal is the most common label. Macro-F1 on a balanced set rewards equal performance across classes, which is not the same as the cost of errors in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 结构效度。 真值是 Bugzilla 中记录的严重级别，其本身带有噪声 [ 28 ]；我们数据池中有 41 条完全相同的描述却带有相互冲突的标签，而且我们没有对样本进行人工核查。 将 blocker 合并到 Critical 并丢弃 normal，定义了一个比真实分类任务更窄的任务，而 normal 恰恰是实践中最常见的标签。 在均衡数据集上，宏平均 F1 奖励各类别上的均衡表现，这与实际中错误的代价并不是一回事。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. The zero-shot and fine-tuned conditions differ in more than training (Section 7.1 ). The LLM outputs were parsed with a fallback whose firing rate is unknown. CodeBERT’s checkpoint was chosen on the test split, although the choice coincided with the last epoch. The TF-IDF classifiers saw 12,800 training reports and the other models 16,000. Each model was trained once with a single seed, and LLM inference sampled at temperature 0.1 without a fixed seed, so run-to-run variation is not covered by our intervals. We did not compare the NF4 training-time models with their Q4_K_M exports, and the Ollama version, model digests and context setting of the zero-shot runs were not recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 零样本条件与微调条件之间的差异不仅在于训练（见第 7.1 节）。 大语言模型的输出通过一个触发率未知的后备解析器进行解析。 CodeBERT 的检查点是在测试集上选出的，尽管该选择恰好对应最后一个训练轮次。 TF-IDF 分类器使用了 12,800 份训练报告，而其他模型使用了 16,000 份。 每个模型仅以单一随机种子训练一次，且大语言模型推理在温度 0.1 下采样而无固定种子，因此各次运行之间的波动未包含在我们的区间估计中。 我们没有将 NF4 训练时的模型与其 Q4_K_M 导出版本进行比较，且零样本运行的 Ollama 版本、模型摘要和上下文设置均未记录。

paragraphs.en: External validity. All data come from one project, Eclipse, and from reports that were later resolved; about 1% of descriptions include notes added after filing, and labels may have been revised after filing. The test set is balanced, the sample includes repeated reports, and we have neither a natural-prevalence test set nor a temporal or cross-project split. The prevalence estimate in Section 5.3 is a re-weighting and ignores the normal reports that would dominate a real stream.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 所有数据来自同一个项目 Eclipse，且均为后来被解决的报告；约 1% 的描述包含提交后添加的备注，标签也可能在提交后被修改。 测试集是均衡的，样本中包含重复报告，而且我们既没有自然占比的测试集，也没有按时间或跨项目的划分。 5.3 节中的占比估计是一种重新加权，忽略了在真实数据流中会占主导地位的正常报告。

sents.zh: 外部效度。

paragraphs.en: Conclusion validity. The LLMs were evaluated on 2,000 of the 4,000 test reports, which widens intervals; differences below about 0.03 in macro-F1 are not resolvable here. The bootstrap treats reports as independent, although 41 test rows repeat a bug ID already in the test split (18 repeated descriptions in the shared subset). We limited formal testing to ten comparisons selected from the research questions and corrected for multiplicity within each test.
paragraphs.zh: 结论效度。 大语言模型在 4,000 份测试报告中的 2,000 份上进行了评估，这会加宽置信区间；约 0.03 以下的宏平均 F1 差异在此无法区分。 自助法（bootstrap）将报告视为相互独立，尽管有 41 条测试行重复了测试集中已有的 bug ID（共享子集中有 18 条重复描述）。 我们将正式检验限定为从研究问题中选出的十次比较，并在每次检验内部对多重性进行了校正。

paragraphs.en: We compared TF-IDF classifiers, a fine-tuned CodeBERT encoder and two open 7–8B LLMs, prompted and QLoRA-fine-tuned, on the same 2,000 Eclipse bug reports, using numbers rebuilt from stored predictions. The zero-shot runs scored below every TF-IDF classifier. The fine-tuned runs scored far higher, in a setup that changed more than training. Fine-tuned Llama 3 8B showed no detectable difference from CodeBERT, at a much higher cost per report, and fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 7B was below CodeBERT on macro-F1. The fine-tuned models differed most in how they traded one class against another, and none of them found Critical reports reliably enough to work without review. The data audit showed that the public dump is Eclipse-only and repeats rows, and that the repeats reach the test set and inflate the TF-IDF scores while leaving the LLM comparison as it was.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在同一批 2,000 份 Eclipse 缺陷报告上比较了 TF-IDF 分类器、一个经过微调的 CodeBERT 编码器以及两个开源 7–8B 大语言模型（分别使用提示和 QLoRA 微调），所用的指标数字由存储的预测结果重新计算得出。 零样本运行的成绩低于所有 TF-IDF 分类器。 微调运行的成绩远高于前者，但这一设置改变的不只是训练本身。 微调后的 Llama 3 8B 与 CodeBERT 相比没有可检测的差异，而每份报告的成本要高得多；微调后的 Qwen 2.5 7B 在 macro-F1 上低于 CodeBERT。 微调后的模型之间最大的差异在于它们如何在不同类别之间进行取舍，而且没有一个模型能够足够可靠地识别出 Critical 报告以支持免审核使用。 数据审计表明，公开数据转储只包含 Eclipse 数据且存在重复行，这些重复行进入了测试集并抬高了 TF-IDF 的分数，而大语言模型的比较结果则保持不变。
